newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay bourse turnover to double in 6 months-chief.
newsitem.headline: Bombay bourse turnover to double in 6 months-chief.

text.p: Daily turnover on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE), India's oldest bourse, is expected to double within six months, the exchange chief said on Thursday.
"We expect (daily) turnover to touch 20 billion rupees within six months and 25 billion by end-December 1997," BSE president M.G.Damani said at the exchange's annual general meeting.
The bourse currently has a daily turnover of about 10 billion rupees.
He said the exchange would complete formalities required to expand outside Bombay within a week.
Damani said the BSE plans to operate from 135 centres across the country.
